subject: Kickoff: console walkthrough + API enablement — availability sync
messages:
From: Amelia Tran <amelia@finvest.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff + console walkthrough — availability next week?

Hi Hannah / Jordan,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to get a hands-on session scheduled for next week to walk our platform team through the Redwood Console and basic API enablement. Goal is: 1) console walkthrough for product managers (overview, routes, billing view), 2) API enablement for two backend engineers (sandbox keys, rate-limits, streaming example).

Our constraints: engineers are only available in the mornings PT; procurement wants the session to be under 2 hours if possible. Can you share a few 90–120 minute windows next week? Also curious whether you can split the session (45–60m console + 30–45m API) if that helps.

I've attached our network checklist we'd like you to confirm before the lab (network port + firewall notes). Also: will you record the session?

Thanks —
Amelia Tran
Director of Integrations, Finvest
amelia@finvest.com
+1 415-555-0142

Attachment: finvest_network_requirements.xlsx (XLSX)

Hi Amelia —

Great to hear — we're excited to get Finvest onboard. Quick answers up-front: we can record (recording will be shared internally and with your team), and splitting into console + API works well. Camila (cc'd) will lead the API half; Jordan will support the console section.

Proposed windows next week (PT):
- Tue Aug 4, 09:00–10:30 PT (preferred)
- Tue Aug 4, 11:00–12:30 PT (backup)
- Wed Aug 5, 08:30–10:00 PT (alternate)

If you need strictly morning-only for engineers, the 09:00 slot is best. I've attached a short draft agenda / pre-read — keeps it to ~90 minutes with a short Q&A. Can you confirm attendees (names + roles) so we can tailor demos?

Draft agenda attached: handbook_onboard_agenda_v0.1.pdf (PDF)

Also: can you confirm whether your environment will allow outbound TLS on ports 443 and 8443 (per your checklist)? If there are strict proxies, let us know and we'll provide alternate steps.

Thanks,

hannah@redwood.ai | +1 206-555-0233
